children: Meta Platforms Inc.

) stock rose more than 1% Friday as investors moved into mega-cap growth stocks. Communication Services was among the market’s strongest sectors. The Nasdaq gained more than 1%, while the S&P 500 rose 1.06%.
Meta Meets European Bond Investors

Separately, Meta has been meeting with European bond investors for at least a week as Big Tech companies seek more funding for the AI infrastructure boom, Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
The company has not provided a timeline for a potential bond sale. The meetings are part of a non-deal roadshow, which does not guarantee an offering.
A European deal would mark Meta’s first debt issuance outside the U.S. dollar market. The company last raised debt in April through a $25 billion, six-part bond offering.
The move comes as other technology giants tap overseas debt markets.
Amazon.com Inc.
) recently raised 4.25 billion pounds ($5.75 billion) in its U.K. sterling bond market debut.
Alphabet Inc.
GOOGL) has also raised debt across several international markets this year.
Technical Analysis
Meta shares are trading 11.3% above their 20-day simple moving average of $586.69. The stock is also 4.7% above its 200-day SMA of $623.25.

That setup points to improving short-term momentum. However, the longer-term technical picture remains mixed. Meta’s 20-day SMA is below its 50-day SMA, while its 50-day SMA remains below the 200-day SMA.
The stock formed a death cross in December 2025.
Meanwhile, MACD is above its signal line, and the histogram is positive. That suggests buying momentum is improving.
Resistance sits near $686, while support is around $556.50.
Meta Analyst Outlook
Meta carries a Buy consensus rating and an average price forecast of $772.46.
JPMorgan
upgraded the stock to Overweight on Sept. 10 and raised its price forecast to $820.
Wedbush
maintained a Neutral rating and $595 forecast on Sept. 1.
Rosenblatt
maintained Buy and raised its forecast to $886 on Aug. 27.
Benzinga Edge Rankings
The Benzinga Edge scorecard gives Meta a Growth score of 79.38 out of 100. Quality stands at 67.21, while Value is 50.21.
The scores point to a growth-heavy profile with more moderate readings for quality and valuation.
Meta ETF Exposure
The stock is a major holding in the
First Trust Dow Jones Internet Index Fund
(NYSE:FDN), with a 9.46% weighting. It also accounts for 8.91% of the
Invesco AI and Next Gen Software ETF
(NYSE:IGPT) and 8.76% of the
Global X Social Media ETF
(NASDAQ:SOCL).
Its large weighting means significant fund flows into or out of these ETFs can influence demand for Meta shares.
Price Action
META Price Action:
Meta Platforms shares were up 1.27% at $652.57 at the time of publication on Friday, according to Benzinga Pro data.
